items.scope: Require and preserve the personal series-agent acceptance for a new-company SELF order; enforce applicant identity in client and server. Existing-company keep-agent path remains as previously approved.

Describe distinguishability accurately, preserve the consent exception where relevant, and apply tested local collision checks. Keep a separately identified office/live-record review for existing filings; do not promise complete statutory validation from this normalizer.

Use management information to avoid the false Manager assumption, and ask the client to confirm the authorized signer and actual title. A blank required title with clear help is safer than inventing office status from management type.
Use the neutral heading “Responsible party” and retain the existing explanation of ultimate ownership or control.

Track whether each address came from saved/imported data; clear that status on typing for both owners; show no on-file label on unsaved typed text. Preserve lookup verification and correctly initialize reopened saved drafts.
Apply formatDate to all four resignation/end-date interpolations in the registered-agent card.
Restore “Documents are download-only.” before the current retention explanation, preserving the current support link and encrypted-retention wording.

Allocate the number after validation, stale-draft and rate-limit refusals, and assign inputs.generationNumber after allocation. Preserve never-reuse behavior; do not promise gap-free numbering after rendering/storage failures.

Describe the record as recently inactive and explain that this service conservatively treats the name as unavailable. Do not claim the mirror proves dissolution; preserve the owner-approved blocking rule.
